The Martial eagle is arguably ‘Africa’s ultimate Eagle’ due to its size and incredible hunting ability, and Steve Backshall is determined to pull out all the stops for one last attempt at filming a hunt at breakfast time. To get up close to this magnificent bird, the crew spends the night camping at high altitude in a cosy tree canopy, but the sound of a wild beast and thousands of bats prevent Steve from a good night’s sleep…

Meet the reticulated python, the longest snake on Earth.
Hidden in a cave, this incredible predator uses camouflage, lightning-fast strikes, and powerful constriction to hunt prey, even snatching bats from the air. Get up close with one of nature’s most impressive and deadly serpents.

Join Big Manny for a fun Drawalong and learn how to draw a beaver with a bubbling science beaker! 🦫🧪 

Big Manny is a science content creator who makes amazing science videos online, and in this step-by-step drawing tutorial he'll show you how to create your very own science-loving beaver.

As you draw, you'll discover fascinating science facts about:

Beavers and their incredible building skills 🦫 
Carbon dioxide and bubbling reactions 🧪
The periodic table and colourful flame tests 🔥
Acids, alkalis and pH indicators 🌈

Grab some paper, pencils and colouring pens, then follow along with Big Manny to create your own colourful science masterpiece!

Learn how to draw Bunny and Monkey with Jamie Smart, the bestselling creator of the hit comic series Bunny vs Monkey and Looshkin.

In this fun step-by-step drawing tutorial, Jamie shows you how simple shapes like circles, squares, triangles and heart shapes can be used to create expressive cartoon characters. Follow along as he draws Bunny, Monkey, bees, background scenery and adds colour, shading and movement to bring the characters to life.

Perfect for:
✅ Kids who love drawing
✅ Fans of Bunny vs Monkey
✅ Beginners learning cartoon art
✅ Teachers and parents looking for creative activities
✅ Comic and illustration enthusiasts

In this video you'll learn:

How to draw Bunny step by step
How to draw Monkey step by step
Using basic shapes to build characters
Cartoon facial expressions
Adding movement and action
Simple colouring and shading techniques
Tips from professional comic artist Jamie Smart

Don't forget to like and subscribe for more fun art tutorials and creative drawing activities.
